title: Webhook delivery status values disagree with database constraint
notes: Cluster G from the final integration run: webhook transaction rollback, orphan pickup, and pause-subscription target tests insert pending, failed, or BOGUS values that violate webhook_deliveries_status_check. Evidence: _integration_final.log lines 6576-6730.
root_cause: Category D (test error). Migration 085 and ISS-0205 corrected dispatcher.zig to write uppercase status values (PENDING, DELIVERED, FAILED) matching the CHECK constraint. The test file ext02_webhook_dispatch_test.zig was not updated: line 589 expected 'failed' (should be 'FAILED'), line 654 expected 'exhausted' (should be 'FAILED'), line 754 expected 'success' (should be 'DELIVERED').
candidate_resolution: Update three expectEqualStrings calls in tests/integration/ext02_webhook_dispatch_test.zig: 'failed'->'FAILED', 'exhausted'->'FAILED', 'success'->'DELIVERED'. No production code changes required.
resolution: Updated three expectEqualStrings assertions in tests/integration/ext02_webhook_dispatch_test.zig: 'failed'->'FAILED', 'exhausted'->'FAILED', 'success'->'DELIVERED'. TC-EXT-02-INT-06/07/09 now pass. WF03-GH381-20260809.
prevention: After any migration that renames or remaps status enum values, update all test assertions in the same commit.
